title: Discover, probe and retire models since the last scout
goal: Snapshot each provider's catalogue at every scout, diff it against the previous snapshot, probe the newly appeared models cheaply, and mark the retired ones without deleting their history. A catalogue change - a new model, a retired one, a changed price or context limit - is an event that can re-trigger ranking, so a model that outranks the incumbent does not wait for a human to notice it: actively scouting for the best brain means the candidate set keeps itself current.
